title: Thanking Someone Sincerely
paragraphs: Suatu sore, lift di gedung Aisyah rusak. Seorang asing membantunya membawa tas berat naik tiga lantai. Aisyah tidak hanya mengangguk lalu pergi. Ia ingin berterima kasih dengan baik. Ia menatap orang itu dan berkata, "Terima kasih banyak." Ia menjelaskan bahwa bantuan itu membuat sorenya lebih mudah. Ia tidak berbicara tergesa-gesa atau menoleh ke pintunya saat berbicara.

Pria itu sedikit terkejut. Ia berkata banyak orang hanya bicara sedikit setelah mendapat bantuan kecil. Di gedung yang sibuk, orang sering berpapasan tanpa berbicara. Kemudian, Aisyah memikirkan kejadian itu. Ucapan terima kasih yang tulus tidak membutuhkan uang atau waktu lama. Tetapi ucapan itu dapat menunjukkan kepada orang baik bahwa bantuannya berarti.
answerKey: One afternoon, the elevator in Aisyah's building is broken. A stranger helps her carry her heavy bags up three floors. Aisyah does not only nod and walk away. She wants to thank him well. She looks at him and says, "Thank you so much." She tells him that his help made her afternoon easier. She does not speak quickly or look at her door while she talks. The man is a little surprised. He says that many people say very little after small help. In a busy building, people often walk past each other without talking. Later, Aisyah thinks about that moment. A true thank you does not cost money or take long. But it can show a kind stranger that his help mattered.
